settings.tab_content: Artisanal vegetable tanned leather from certified partner tanneries in Kanpur. Finished naturally with organic tree barks and wattle dyes.
Constructed with a Goodyear welt, allowing the shoe to be completely resoled repeatedly, extending its lifetime by several years.
Internal cork mid-sole filling that naturally moulds to the exact contours of your feet over time, creating a custom fit.
Packaged in a reusable timber case made from FSC certified plantation pines. 100% biodegradable tissue fillers.
